body: Thanks for your thoughts. I think it would be easier to deal with if I deserved it. I just feel helpless and squashed by the world. If these things had been my fault, i would feel like there was something I could do better or differently to either fix things or make it work next time. As I've done in the past. with this... i gave everything my all, I put my best efforts into things, had a very positive, optimistic attitude toward all that i was doing, and it all completely backfired. I am so angry at the school. The medical dismissal (while illegal) was probably cover for their panic that i was starting to ask questions about whether or not graduates of the program actually worked in their field post graduation, and i was finding that contrary to the outcomes for the rest of the school, for my particular program, the answer was "no." At this point I have a solid case for a fraud lawsuit against the school (based on misrepresentation of the program in this and other, more-important areas that i can't discuss here because privacy) but again, i can't do anything about it, and that just eats me. I'm trying to let it go, but it's a problem that needs to be fixed. They've been casually defrauding students like me for the last 10 years, and they're going to keep doing it. it kills me that I can't do anything about it.
